author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
If you watched Project Hail Mary in 70MM IMAX this year, this was the machine where that large format print was made. Adam Savage takes a close-up look at FotoKem's custom-built Scorpion film recorder, which puts any digital image onto 70MM film, including the commemorative film strips given out at IMAX film screenings. We learn how the Scorpion was built and how FotoKem is opening up its capabilities for film fans to make their own custom filmstrips!

FotoKem FotoBooth custom filmstrips: https://fotobooth.fotokem.com/
